name: Intercontinental Bordeaux Le Grand Hotel
positioning: The InterContinental Bordeaux - Le Grand Hotel, a historic hotel on Place de la Comedie opposite the Grand Theatre, with Jacques Garcia-designed rooms, a Guerlain spa and a rooftop terrace over the city
best_for: Travelers who want a central Bordeaux base facing the Grand Theatre, within walking distance of the Miroir d'Eau
Guests who want a spa with an indoor pool and a rooftop with panoramic city views

facts.text: The hotel is at 2 Place de la Comédie in Bordeaux.
For more than 200 years, the Grand Hotel de Bordeaux has been a luxury hotel in the heart of Bordeaux.
Rooms and suites are inspired by the eighteenth century and have modern amenities.
The hotel has an indoor pool.
Between treatments, guests can have fruit, tea or other drinks in the spa's tea room or, weather permitting, on a terrace with a panoramic view of Bordeaux.
At Le Pressoir d'Argent, the menu is crafted by chef Gordon Ramsay using seasonal ingredients.
The rooftop bar is on the 7th-floor rooftop terrace and has a 360-degree panoramic view of the city.
The Miroir d'Eau is about 0.6 kilometers from the hotel.
Saint-André Cathedral is about 0.7 kilometers from the hotel.
The concierge team can help rent electric scooters, bikes or cars.
Pets are welcome at the hotel.

highlights.text: The rooftop has panoramic views over the city, lush plants, bird cages, lounge furniture and a rooftop bar.
The spa is run by Guerlain, the house of fragrance and cosmetics, and offers a large menu of relaxing treatments.
The fabrics, upholstery and carpets in the rooms were designed by Jacques Garcia.
The hotel stands opposite the eighteenth-century Grand Théâtre.
Some rooms offer views of the Opera.

considerations.text: Parking under the hotel is limited and must be reserved at the time of booking.
Bordeaux-Mérignac Airport is about 20 kilometers from the hotel.
Le Pressoir d'Argent has a formal dress code.
